TextView.android:text: On-Screen Interface Elements
Customize the HUD, radar minimap, crosshair style, shortcut keys, and player overhead info
Show GTA Original HUD (Health/Weapon/Money)
Show health, armor, weapon icon, wanted stars, and cash at the top right
Show Bottom-Left Radar Minimap
Show the circular radar minimap and map markers
Tap Radar to Open Big Map
Tap the bottom-left radar to open the fullscreen map; turning it off prevents accidental map pop-ups from joystick touches during combat
Weapon Crosshair Style
Switch between the original crosshair, competitive minimal cross, highlighted center dot, or hidden crosshair
Live FPS Display
Show the current game frame rate at the screen edge
Right-Side Kill Feed
Show the kill and death icon list between server players
Player Overhead Names & Health Bars
Render the names, health, and armor bars of other players and bots in view
Show Held Weapon Above Player Names
Show the weapon icon badge for the weapon another player is currently holding, just above their name
Bottom Quick Function Keyboard
Provides an expandable TAB, ALT, Y, N, H, G, F shortcut key bar at the bottom left
Quick Keyboard Includes F8 Screenshot Key
Show a one-tap F8 screenshot button at the end of the bottom quick keyboard
Bottom Hints & Story Subtitles
Show mission subtitles and hint text at the bottom of the game screen
Fonts, 3D Text & Chat Settings
Game Font Style
Choose the font for chat, overhead names, and 3D text (for a custom font, put it in SAMP/fonts/custom.ttf)
Player Overhead Name & Health Bar Size
Scale overhead nicknames, health/armor bars, and weapon icons independently
3D Scene Text (3DText) Size
Scale the 3D floating text the server creates on buildings, NPCs, and license plates independently
Use Phone System Keyboard
When typing in chat, open the phone keyboard directly, making it easy to type Chinese characters and emoji
Show Chat Message Time
Show an HH:MM:SS time stamp before each chat message
Chat Text Outline Shadow
Add a black outline to chat text so it stays readable against bright skies
Chat Window Lines
Number of chat messages shown per page (5 to 20 lines)
Chat & Interface Font Size
Adjust chat message and server popup font size (default 25)
Chat Window Position & Size
Fine-tune the chat box's on-screen coordinates and width/height
Reset Chat Box Layout
Horizontal Position Offset
Vertical Position Offset
Chat Window Width
Chat Window Height
